Pending disposal of the above writ petition,
petitioner prays that this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to stay all further proceedings pursuant to the impugned Order bearing No.EC420, dated 09-12-2024, produced at Annexure-'M'
issued by the 2nd respondent and issue directions to the respondents to permit the petitioners to admit the students to 1st year D. Pharma for the year 2024- 25."

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned HCGP for respondent Nos.1 and 4 and learned counsel for respondent Nos.2 and 3 and perused the material on record.
3.

When the matter came up before this Court on 17.03.2025, this Court passed the following interim order:
"Sri. S.S. Haveri, learned counsel is directed to accept notice for respondent Nos.2 and 3.
Learned AGA is directed to accept notice for respondent Nos.1 and 4.

Under identical circumstances, in relation to the Oriental College of Pharmacy, the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in W.P.No.200467/2025 passed an interim order dated 20.02.2025, which reads as under:
"Sri. S.S.Haveri is directed to accept notice for respondent No.1.
NC: 2025:KHC:53304 HC-KAR Learned Additional Government Advocate is directed to accept notice for respondent Nos.2 and 3.
Pending consideration of the writ petition, the petitioner is permitted to admit students for the academic year 2024 - 2025 for the 1st year of D-Pharmacy course.
However, this is subject to outcome of this writ petition.
In the meanwhile, the respondent No.1 is directed to report whether the petitioner has complied the observations made by the respondent No.1 at its E.C.Meeting dated 30.09.2024."

In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances and the interim order passed under identical circumstances by this Court referred to supra, there shall be an interim order of stay as prayed for by the petitioner in the present petition till the next date of hearing.
Office objections to be complied with by the next date of hearing.
Re

The Petitioner hereby prays to this Hon'ble Court that this memo may be considered in the interest of justice and equity."
5.
As can be seen from the documents produced by the petitioner, respondents have granted approval in favour of the petitioner-Institution up to the academic year 2025-26.

Under these circumstances, I deem it just and appropriate to dispose of this petition by quashing the impugned order dated 09.12.2024, vide Annexure-M, under which approval for the year 2024-25 has been rejected by the respondents.

6. In the result, I pass the following:
ORDER (i) The petition is allowed in view of extention of approval in favour of the petitioner-Institution up to the academic year 2025-26.
NC: 2025:KHC:53304 HC-KAR (ii) The impugned order at Annexure-M dated 09.12.2024 issued by respondent No.2 is hereby quashed.

(iii) The respondents are directed to open the website/portal and permit the petitioner/students to upload the details of the students and also permit the students of the petitioner/Institution to attend Bangalore City College Of Pharmacy vs The State Of Karnataka on 15 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/195452516/
